metadata.text: [Public record · High Court of Punjab and Haryana, CRM-M-9546-2025, order dated 2025-02-24 · names pseudonymised] Facts as recorded in the order: in the FIR, on 06.11.2023, [Name W1] @ [Person X1], a 12 th class student along with his mother [Name W2], filed a complaint at Police Post [Name W3] Mandi, in which [Name W1] reported that while riding his scooty bearing registration No.[vehicle no. withheld] to school with friends [Name W4] and [Person X3], they were confronted by four boys namely [Accused A1] (petitioner), [Person X4], [Name W5] @ [Person X2], and [Name W6], who stopped them on their motorcycle. The assailants physically assaulted [Name W4] and [Person X3] before forcibly taking [Name W1] to a secluded area. During the attack, [Name W6] and [Person X4] were armed with a Kapa, while [Name W5] had a Danda. [Name W1] was injured when [Person X4] cut his right hand, and [Accused A1] struck him with the Kapa. The assailant s continued to beat [Name W1], despite his pleas for mercy, and thr eatened his life before leaving the spot with their weapons on two motorc ycles. The motive for the attack was reportedly retaliation for a pre vious incident where friends of [Name W1] had beaten [Accused A1]. Following this account, the FIR (supra) was registered based on [Name W1]'s complaint. Court proceedings: petition for regular bail by [Accused A1]; outcome: Allowed.
